story.titleZh: 维斯塔潘F1荷兰大奖赛撞车原因分析
story.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在主场荷兰大奖赛首圈发生撞车，他解释这是一次车手失误。从第七位发车后，他在一号弯前陷入四车并行，被挤上草地，随后在接下来的弯道中与红牛替补利亚姆·劳森竞争时发生事故。

story.originalTitle: What caused Verstappen’s F1 Dutch GP crash
story.summaryEn: Max Verstappen crashed on the first lap of his home Dutch Grand Prix, which he explained was a driver error. Starting seventh, he was squeezed onto the grass in a four-wide moment on the run to Turn 1, and then collided while battling Red Bull stand-in Liam Lawson in the following corners.
detailZh: 是什么导致了维斯塔潘在F1荷兰大奖赛中的撞车
马克斯·维斯塔潘解释了这起最终被认定为车手失误的事件
犯错或许不符合马克斯·维斯塔潘的一贯风格，但这正是这位四届世界冠军在他主场F1比赛第一圈所做的事。
由于整个周末都感觉身体不适，维斯塔潘从第七位发车开启荷兰大奖赛，他的起步还算不错，但在通往1号弯的路上，四车并排的瞬间他被挤到了草地上。随后他在接下来的几个弯角中受到了红牛替补车手利亚姆·劳森的挑战——他对此并不介意：“我们被允许比赛，所以我认为这很正常。”
维斯塔潘最终守住了第七名的位置，但发车前约50分钟的一场阵雨让赛道变得潮湿，两名车手在第一圈倾斜的最后一个弯角中失控。
虽然加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托在360度旋转后毫发无损地脱险，但红牛的超级巨星无法控制小红牛22，遭遇了严重撞车，导致红旗出动。
“我认为起步只是右侧所发生情况的后果。没关系，这种事会发生，”维斯塔潘在谈到灯灭时的这起事件时评论道。
“然后，是的，我被坑了。那个弯角仍然相当湿，当我一看到干燥的路面出现时，我就想，‘现在你可以加速了’，但显然那没有奏效。所以可能还是有点太早了。”
维斯塔潘将这次撞击描述为“一次相当严重的撞击”，但澄清说他“经历过更糟的”。
从结果来看，红牛最终经历了自四月休赛期以来最糟糕的大奖赛，劳森是它排名最高的车手，位列第七。
维斯塔潘确实承认，就速度而言，这是一个“令人失望的周末”，因为迈凯伦、法拉利和梅赛德斯都遥不可及，但这种情况对他来说并不意外。
“我希望得到更多，但本赛季你必须现实一点，”这位红牛车手坚持说道。“我们是第四快的车队，所以这不像走到赞德福特就能突然施展一些魔法。
“情况就是这样，其他车队带来了升级，而我们没有。当你已经处于劣势时，这只会让你更加被动。所以，没有什么好惊讶的，这就是我们面对的现实。”
因此，维斯塔潘现在将专注于在两周后的意大利大奖赛前休息：“我只是感觉不太舒服。我期待着一个能让我恢复的休息期，因为我真的感觉不好。”
detailEn: What caused Verstappen’s F1 Dutch GP crash
Max Verstappen has explained what turned out to be a driver error
Making mistakes may be uncharacteristic of Max Verstappen, but that’s exactly what the four-time world champion did on the first lap of his home Formula 1 race.

Starting the Dutch Grand Prix from seventh on the grid after feeling unwell all weekend, Verstappen took a decent getaway but found himself squeezed on the grass in a four-wide moment on the run to Turn 1. He was consequently challenged by Red Bull stand-in Liam Lawson in the following corners – which he didn’t mind: “We are allowed to race, so I think that's normal.”

Verstappen eventually held on to that seventh position, but a rain shower which occurred some 50 minutes before the start had dampened the track, and two drivers lost control in the banked final corner on lap one.
While Gabriel Bortoleto escaped from a 360-degree pirouette unscathed, Red Bull’s superstar couldn’t catch the RB22 and suffered a substantial crash, which caused a red flag.
“I think the start is just a consequence of what is happening on the right. It's OK, it can happen,” Verstappen commented regarding about the incident at lights out.

“Then, yeah, I got caught out. It was still quite wet in that corner, and as soon as I saw the dry patch coming, I was like, ‘Now you can accelerate’, but clearly that didn't work. So probably it was still a bit too early.”
Verstappen described the impact as “a decent hit” but clarified he’d “had worse”.
Red Bull eventually endured its worst grand prix since the April break results-wise, with Lawson its top car in seventh.
Verstappen did admit to “a disappointing weekend” in terms of pace as McLaren, Ferrari and Mercedes were out of reach, but this situation was no surprise to him.

“I wish for more, but you need to be realistic this season,” the Red Bull racer insisted. “We are the fourth-fastest team, so it's not like walking up to Zandvoort and suddenly we can do some magic things.

“It's just how it is, other teams have brought upgrades, we haven't. When you're already on the back foot, it puts you even more on the back foot. So, there's nothing surprising, it's just the reality that we live in.”

So Verstappen will now focus on resting ahead of the Italian Grand Prix, two weeks from now: “I've just not been feeling well. I'm just looking forward to a break where I can just recover also, because I really didn't feel good.”
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘整个周末身体不适，从第七位发车。
维斯塔潘表示与劳森的竞争是正常比赛，称“我们被允许比赛，所以我认为这很正常。”
keyPointsEn: Verstappen felt unwell all weekend and started the race from seventh on the grid.
Verstappen said racing Lawson was normal, stating: "We are allowed to race, so I think that's normal."

detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
